## Introduction

- The digestive system breaks down food  
- It helps the body get nutrients  
- Nutrients give us energy  

---

## Main Organs

- Mouth → starts digestion  
- Esophagus → moves food  
- Stomach → breaks down food  
- Small intestine → absorbs nutrients  
- Large intestine → removes waste  

---

## Digestion Process

- Mechanical digestion → chewing  
- Chemical digestion → enzymes break food  

---

## Absorption

- Happens in the small intestine  
- Nutrients go into the blood  

Digestion and absorption happen in the digestive system [@openstax_ap].

---

## Functions

1. Break down food  
2. Absorb nutrients  
3. Remove waste  

---

## Conclusion

- The digestive system is important  
- It helps the body stay healthy  
- It provides energy
